title: Founder and Perfecter of Our Faith
speaker: Jonathan Baird
summary: When we stumble, Jesus isn't done with us. Knowing he won't give up is what gives us the confidence to repent and come quickly to him.
exhortation: I am so grateful that Jesus is both the founder and the perfecter of our faith. When I stumble and fall, it's so comforting to know that Jesus isn't done with me. He is still working in me and through me to change me.

Yes, I need to repent and change and work out my salvation with fear and trembling. But the drive and the ability to do that come from knowing that Jesus is working and won't give up. That is what gives me the confidence to humble myself, repent and come quickly to Jesus.
Remember today that Jesus endured the cross and despised the shame so that we would be conformed to his likeness. Even when we mess up, he is faithful, and he will finish the work he started.
prayer: Lord, as we go through this world, we are working out our salvation with fear and trembling, seeking to live holy lives set apart for you. We run to your cross daily because we need it daily. We need to be reminded of what you accomplished for us there, and to keep repenting and seeking you, Lord Jesus.

But we long for the day when all the repenting is over: when we see you and are made new in a moment, and every fear, pain, sickness and disease, all the terrible things that ravage us on this earth, pass away and we are with you forever. We long for that day. You are our hope, Jesus. May we set our hearts and minds fully on you. Amen.
